#535 · Tadpole Pokémon

Tympole

Water

Unova · Generation 5

Tympole is a Water-type Tadpole Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 4.5 kg. It evolves into Palpitoad. Its highest base stat is Speed (64), with a base stat total of 294.
